questions.question: The intersection of Rational and Irrational numbers is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Rational numbers** and **Irrational numbers** are mutually exclusive categories by definition.

A **Rational number** can be written as a fraction, while an **Irrational number** cannot.

Since no number can satisfy both properties simultaneously, their **intersection** is always empty.

**∴ The correct answer is Empty.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Two sets of numbers − **Rational (Q)** and **Irrational (Qc)**.

**Property:** Real Numbers (R) = Rational Numbers (Q) ∪ Irrational Numbers (Qc).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b823fde8268f7b77edbb9e263853f6fd954a63776eccd0afad61d5d1515ab83.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let Q = {p/q : p, q are **integers** and q ≠ 0}

⇒ Let Q' = {x : x is a **real number** and x is **not rational**}

⇒ Intersection (Q ∩ Q') represents elements present in both sets.

⇒ Since Q and Q' are **disjoint sets** by definition, Q ∩ Q' = ∅

**∴ The correct answer is Empty.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Real Number System

The set of **Real Numbers (R)** is the union of **Rational (Q)** and **Irrational (Q')** numbers; mathematically, R = Q ∪ Q'.

Rational Numbers

These include integers, terminating decimals (e.g., 0.25), and **non-terminating repeating** decimals (e.g., 0.333...).

Irrational Numbers

These consist of **non-terminating and non-repeating** decimals, such as π and √2.

Disjoint Sets

Two sets are **disjoint** if they have no common elements, meaning their intersection is the **Null set** or **Empty set** (∅).</p

questions.question: Which number is NOT real?
questions.solution:
**Concept Used:**

A real number is a number that can be located on a number line and does not involve the square root of a negative number.

**Calculation:**

⇒ √7 is a real number because the square root of a positive number is real.

⇒ √-7 is not a real number because the square root of a negative number is imaginary.

⇒ 1/√7 is a real number because it involves only the division of real numbers.

⇒ -√7 is a real number because it is the negative of a real square root.

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**

questions.question: The number of rational numbers between any two rational numbers is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The number of rational numbers between any two rational numbers is:

**Formula Used:**

Rational numbers are numbers that can be expressed as a ratio of integers (p/q).

Between any two rational numbers, there exists infinitely many other rational numbers.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let two rational numbers be a/b and c/d.

⇒ Calculate the average: (a/b + c/d) ÷ 2 = (ad + bc)/(2bd).

⇒ This average is also a rational number and lies between a/b and c/d.

⇒ Repeat the process to find infinitely many rational numbers between the two rational numbers.

**∴ The correct answer is Infinite.**

questions.question: If 8 men can do a piece of work in 14 days, the time taken by 12 men to do the same piece of work will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

8 men can complete the work in 14 days.

12 men need to complete the same work.

**Formula Used:**

Work = Men × Days

Men × Days (initial) = Men × Days (final)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Work by 8 men in 14 days = Work by 12 men in x days

⇒ 8 × 14 = 12 × x

⇒ 112 = 12x

⇒ x = 112 ÷ 12

⇒ x = 9.33 days

**∴ The correct answer is 9.33 days.**

questions.question: In a circle, chord AB subtends 60° at the center. The angle between the tangents at A and B is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **angle between the tangents** drawn from an external point and the **angle subtended by the chord** at the center are **supplementary** (sum to 180°).

⇒ Angle between tangents + Angle at center = 180°

⇒ Angle between tangents + 60° = 180°

⇒ Angle between tangents = 180° − 60° = 120°

**∴ The correct answer is 120°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Angle subtended by chord **AB** at the center (O) = ∠AOB = 60°.

⇒ Tangents are drawn at points **A** and **B**, meeting at an external point **P**.

**Formula Used:**

⇒ The radius is **perpendicular** to the tangent at the point of contact (∠OAP = ∠OBP = 90°).

⇒ Sum of internal angles of a **quadrilateral** = 360°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96b6de82c8daa7024a5d87c9476a15cb6ee53c60632791d463d5b91a0f414650.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ In quadrilateral **OAPB**:

⇒ ∠OAP = 90° (Radius ⊥ Tangent)

⇒ ∠OBP = 90° (Radius ⊥ Tangent)

⇒ ∠AOB = 60° (Given)

⇒ ∠AOB + ∠OAP + ∠APB + ∠OBP = 360°

⇒ 60° + 90° + ∠APB + 90° = 360°

⇒ 240° + ∠APB = 360°

⇒ ∠APB = 360° − 240° = 120°

**∴ The correct answer is 120°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Tangent-Radius Property

The tangent at any point of a circle is perpendicular to the radius through the point of contact.

Length of Tangents

The lengths of tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are always equal (PA = PB).

Angle Bisector Property

The line joining the external point to the center of the circle bisects the angle between the two tangents (∠APO = ∠BPO).

Cyclic Nature

Quadrilateral OAPB is always cyclic because the sum of opposite angles (∠OAP + ∠OBP = 180°) is constant.</p

questions.question: The radius of the circle passing through the vertices of a triangle with sides 6 cm, 8 cm, and 10 cm is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sides = 6, 8, 10

**Formula Used:**

For right triangle: Radius of circumcircle = Hypotenuse ÷ 2

**Calculation:**

⇒ 6² + 8² = 36 + 64 = 100

⇒ √100 = 10

⇒ Radius = 10 ÷ 2

⇒ Radius = 5 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 5 cm.**

questions.question: The circumference of a circle is 132 cm. The radius of the given circle is equal to the radius of a cone having height 12 cm. Find the volume of the cone. (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Circumference = 132

Height of cone = 12

π = 22 ÷ 7

**Formula Used:**

Circumference = 2 × π × r

Volume of cone = (1 ÷ 3) × π × r² × h

**Calculation:**

⇒ 132 = 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × r

⇒ 132 = (44 ÷ 7) × r

⇒ r = 132 × (7 ÷ 44)

⇒ r = 21

⇒ Volume = (1 ÷ 3) × (22 ÷ 7) × 21² × 12

⇒ Volume = (1 ÷ 3) × (22 ÷ 7) × 441 × 12

⇒ Volume = (1 ÷ 3) × 22 × 63 × 12

⇒ Volume = (1 ÷ 3) × 16632

⇒ Volume = 5544

**∴ The correct answer is 5544.**

questions.question: A circle is inscribed in ΔABC, touching AB, BC and AC at the points P, Q and R, respectively. If AB - BC = 4 cm, AB - AC = 2 cm and the perimeter of ΔABC = 36 cm, then PB + AR (in cm ) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

AB - BC = 4

AB - AC = 2

Perimeter = 36

Calculation:

Let AB = c, BC = a, AC = b

Semiperimeter s = (a + b + c) ÷ 2

AP = AR = s - a

BP = s - b

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba182734d11265bbed2e860e3726950db87764bbf0af4fef0645dcc2f3919c80.png] 

⇒ c - a = 4

⇒ c - b = 2

⇒ a + b + c = 36

⇒ a = c - 4, b = c - 2

⇒ (c - 4) + (c - 2) + c = 36

⇒ 3c - 6 = 36

⇒ 3c = 42

⇒ c = 14

⇒ a = 10, b = 12

⇒ s = (10 + 12 + 14) ÷ 2 = 18

⇒ PB = s - b = 18 - 12 = 6

⇒ AR = s - a = 18 - 10 = 8

⇒ PB + AR = 6 + 8 = 14

**∴ The correct answer is 14.**

questions.question:
A man lends out a sum of money by putting 40% of it at 7.5% p.a. simple interest and the remaining 60% at 11.25% p.a. simple interest.

After 2½ years ( 2.5 years) his total interest income is ₹6,825. What was the original sum (principal) he lent?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

40% at 7.5%

60% at 11.25%

Time = 2.5 years

Total interest = 6825

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest = (Principal × Rate × Time) ÷ 100

Total interest = Sum of individual interests

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let total principal = P

⇒ Interest = (0.4P × 7.5 × 2.5 ÷ 100) + (0.6P × 11.25 × 2.5 ÷ 100)

⇒ Interest = (0.4P × 18.75 ÷ 100) + (0.6P × 28.125 ÷ 100)

⇒ Interest = 0.075P + 0.16875P

⇒ Total interest = 0.24375P

⇒ 0.24375P = 6825

⇒ P = 6825 ÷ 0.24375

⇒ P = 28000

**∴ The correct answer is 28000.**

questions.question: In a partnership, the capital ratio between A and B is 5 : 7. If A invested Rs 50,000, how much did B invest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Capital ratio between A and B = 5 : 7

A's investment = Rs 50,000

**Formula Used:**

B's investment = (B's ratio ÷ A's ratio) × A's investment

**Calculation:**

⇒ B's investment = (7 ÷ 5) × 50,000

⇒ B's investment = 1.4 × 50,000

⇒ B's investment = Rs 70,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs 70,000.**

questions.question: Two students' scores are 80% and 90% of a test's total score. What is the ratio of the first student's score to the second student's score?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

First student's score = 80% of the test's total score

Second student's score = 90% of the test's total score

**Formula Used:**

Ratio = (First student's score) ÷ (Second student's score)

Percentage conversion: x% = x ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ First student's score = 80 ÷ 100

⇒ Second student's score = 90 ÷ 100

⇒ Ratio = (80 ÷ 100) ÷ (90 ÷ 100)

⇒ Ratio = 80 ÷ 90

⇒ Ratio = 8 ÷ 9

⇒ Ratio = 8 : 9

**∴ The correct answer is 8 : 9.**

questions.question: The average age of 15 players in a hockey team is the same as it was 4 years ago because 5 players, whose current average age is 28 years, were replaced by 5 new players. What is the average age of the newcomers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total players = 15

Time increase = 4 years

Players replaced = 5

Average age of removed players = 28

**Formula used:**

Change in total age = Number × years

**Calculations:**

Increase in total age in 4 years = 15 × 4 = 60

Since average remains same ⇒ total age must remain same

⇒ Replacement must reduce total age by 60

Removed players total age = 5 × 28 = 140

Let average of new players = x

New players total = 5x

⇒ 140 − 5x = 60

⇒ 5x = 140 − 60 = 80

⇒ x = 80 ÷ 5 = 16

**∴ Average age of newcomers = 16 years.**

questions.question: The average of 15 numbers is 28. If each number is doubled and then 5 is added to each, what will be the new average?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 15 numbers = 28

Each number is doubled and 5 is added to each.

**Formula Used:**

New average = (Old average × multiplier) + increment

Multiplier = 2 (each number is doubled)

Increment = 5 (added to each number)

**Calculation:**

⇒ New average = (28 × 2) + 5

⇒ New average = 56 + 5

⇒ New average = 61

**∴ The correct answer is 61.**

questions.question: A flight covers 1,200 km in 2 hours. By what percent should its speed be decreased to cover the same distance in 3 hours?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

When **distance** is constant, **speed** is inversely proportional to **time**.

Ratio of **time** (T₁ : T₂) = 2 : 3

Ratio of **speed** (S₁ : S₂) = 3 : 2

Decrease in **speed** = (3 − 2) / 3 × 100 = 1/3 × 100 = 33.33%

**∴ The correct answer is 33.33%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Total Distance** = 1,200 km, **Initial Time** = 2 hr, **Target Time** = 3 hr.

**Formula Used:** **Speed** = **Distance** / **Time**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d837ed9c108b06d27eecd8e68a2eb459b6d9bc3df97b2a116790de340c72647.png] 

⇒ **Initial Speed** (S₁) = 1,200 ÷ 2 = 600 kmph

⇒ **Final Speed** (S₂) = 1,200 ÷ 3 = 400 kmph

⇒ **Decrease in speed** = 600 − 400 = 200 kmph

⇒ **Percentage decrease** = (Decrease / Initial Speed) × 100

⇒ **Percentage decrease** = (200 / 600) × 100 = 1/3 × 100 = 33.33%

**∴ The correct answer is 33.33%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Inversely Proportional Relation

When the distance is constant, if the time increases by x%, the speed must decrease to maintain the same distance. Formula: S₁ × T₁ = S₂ × T₂.

Percentage Decrease Formula

Percentage decrease in speed = [(Initial Speed − Final Speed) / Initial Speed] × 100.

Average Speed for Equal Distances

If an object travels equal distances at speeds x and y, the **average speed** is [2 × x × y] / (x + y).</p

questions.question: A shopkeeper offers a 20% discount on the marked price of an article. If the marked price of the article is ₹2,500 and the shopkeeper further gives a 10% discount on the already reduced price, what is the final selling price of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = 2500

First discount = 20%

Second discount = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Selling price after discount = Marked price × (1 - discount)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Price after first discount = 2500 × (1 - 0.20)

⇒ Price after first discount = 2500 × 0.80 = 2000

⇒ Final selling price = 2000 × (1 - 0.10)

⇒ Final selling price = 2000 × 0.90 = 1800

**∴ The correct answer is 1800.**

questions.question: Arrange in ascending order: √3, sqrt[3]{5}, sqrt[4]{6}.
Find the equation of the line with slope-2 passing through the point (3, 5).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Slope = -2

Point = (3, 5)

**Formula Used:**

Point-slope form: y - y₁ = m × (x - x₁)

**Calculation:**

⇒ y - 5 = -2 × (x - 3)

⇒ y - 5 = -2x + 6

⇒ y = -2x + 6 + 5

⇒ y = -2x + 11

**∴ The correct answer is y = -2x + 11.**

questions.question: Two similar triangles have areas of 16 m2 and 25 m2. If the perimeter of the smaller triangle is 20 meters, what is the perimeter of the larger triangle?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of smaller triangle = 16

Area of larger triangle = 25

Perimeter of smaller triangle = 20

**Formula Used:**

Ratio of areas = (Ratio of sides)²

Perimeter ∝ side

**Calculation:**

⇒ Ratio of areas = 25 ÷ 16

⇒ Ratio of sides = √(25 ÷ 16)

⇒ Ratio of sides = 5 ÷ 4

⇒ Perimeter of larger triangle = 20 × 5 ÷ 4

⇒ Perimeter of larger triangle = 25

**∴ The correct answer is 25.**

questions.question: In triangle ABC, D and E are points on sides AB and AC such that DE || BC. If AD = 4 cm, DB = 12 cm, A E = 3 cm, and EC = 9 cm, what is the ratio of the area of triangle ADE to the area of triangle ABC?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

AD = 4

DB = 12

AE = 3

EC = 9

**Formula Used:**

Area ratio of similar triangles = (Ratio of corresponding sides)²

**Calculation:**

⇒ AB = 4 + 12 = 16

⇒ AC = 3 + 9 = 12

⇒ AD ÷ AB = 4 ÷ 16 = 1 ÷ 4

⇒ AE ÷ AC = 3 ÷ 12 = 1 ÷ 4

⇒ Ratio of sides = 1 ÷ 4

⇒ Area ratio = (1 ÷ 4)²

⇒ Area ratio = 1 ÷ 16

**∴ The correct answer is 1 ÷ 16.**
